hook: New cancer-drug prices start, but Hyderabad shelves still hold *old-MRP* stock
hook_b: New cancer-drug prices start, but Hyderabad shelves still hold *old-MRP* stock
tldr: Revised cancer-drug MRPs apply from 9 Nov. Telangana chemists say existing stock bought at higher prices must be returned for reprinted MRPs, so cheaper medicines may take days or weeks to reach shelves.

beats.what: Revised lower MRPs for anti-cancer drugs began. Hyderabad chemists say they paid upfront or on credit for stock at pre-revision prices.
beats.why: Selling old stock at new prices would wipe out margins, the Telangana Druggists and Chemists Association said; stock must go upstream to makers for new MRPs.
beats.care: Patients may see a gap of days or weeks before cheaper cancer medicines reach retail shelves.

effects.label: Stock returned to makers for new MRPs
Cheaper drugs may reach shelves late

cards.title: 🆕 What's new
cards.body: Telangana Today: chemists warn of temporary supply bottlenecks until manufacturers issue credit adjustments and fresh stock with revised MRPs arrives.

cards.q: Have you or family bought cancer medicines recently?

qs: How long will old-MRP stock take to clear, and who bears the cost in the meantime?

facts.t: A cancer drug priced at Rs 28,000 is to cost *Rs 4,840* under new rules
Centre capped trade margins on *137* anti-cancer drugs at 30% of MRP

viz.l: One cancer drug, price per pack
viz.verdict: Patients pay less per pack; chemists carry old-price stock until new MRPs arrive

cover.label: one cancer drug under new rules

insight: Chemists say old stock must go back to makers for reprinted MRPs.

learn.t: MRP = maximum retail price printed on a medicine pack

watch: Whether manufacturers issue credit adjustments and fresh stock with revised MRPs, and how fast it reaches Hyderabad shops.

fact: Hyderabad chemists hold *multi-crore* oncology stock bought at old prices as cheaper MRPs begin.
